name: Dried apricot
description: Apricots dried to leather — Hunza-style, or bright orange from sulphur.

tcm.note: Concentrated by drying; fresh apricot is neutral.

ayurveda.note: Follows the fresh fruit's ushna reading, intensified by drying.

unani.note: Garam, and a standard winter dried fruit alongside anjeer and chuhara.

histamine.note: Dried and usually sulphited — the bright orange ones especially. The brown unsulphured kind is easier.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
